name: Swarna Mahayograj Guggul

sections.reference_sharangadhara_samhita_madhyama: Swarna Mahayograj Guggul is a classical Ayurvedic medicine formulated with a blend of herbal and mineral ingredients, available in tablet form. It is widely used in the management of joint and muscle disorders, including Rheumatoid arthritis, as well as digestive issues, respiratory conditions, urinary disorders, and various types of pain and inflammatory diseases. Its potent combination of ingredients works to reduce inflammation, strengthen the musculoskeletal system, and balance the doshas, making it a valuable remedy for chronic and degenerative conditions.

fullContent:
Swarna Mahayograj Guggul 
 Reference – Sharangadhara Samhita madhyama khanda 7/56-69. 
 Swarna Mahayograj Guggul is a classical Ayurvedic medicine formulated with a blend of herbal and mineral ingredients, available in tablet form. It is widely used in the management of joint and muscle disorders, including Rheumatoid arthritis, as well as digestive issues, respiratory conditions, urinary disorders, and various types of pain and inflammatory diseases. Its potent combination of ingredients works to reduce inflammation, strengthen the musculoskeletal system, and balance the doshas, making it a valuable remedy for chronic and degenerative conditions. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Pippali & Pippalimoola – Pippali Mool 
 Chavya – Piper Chaba 
 Ajamoda – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Indrayava – Holarrhena antidysenterica 
 Patha – Cyclea peltata 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Gajapippali – Scindapsus officinalis 
 Katuki – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Ativisha – Aconitum heterophyllum 
 Murva – Marsdenia tenacissima 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Triphala – Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) , Vibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) and Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) 
 Guggulu – Commiphora mukul 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin Bhasma 
 Raupya Bhasma – Bhasma of Silver 
 Naga Bhasma – Bhasma of Lead 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma of Iron 
 Abhrak Bhasma – Bhasma of Silica 
 Mandura Bhasma – Bhasma of Iron 
 Rasa Sindhura – Mixture of Purified Sulphur and Purified Mercury 
 Svarna Bhasma – Bhasma of Gold 
 
 Dosage 
 1-2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Backache with stiffness 
 Fibromyalgia 
 Gout with joint stiffness 
 Joint stiffness 
 Muscular cramps 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Constipation (due to weakness of intestines and reduce peristalsis) 
 Abdominal distension 
 Bloating 
 Flatulence 
 Indigestion 
 Intestinal Gas 
 Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) 
 Epilepsy 
 Paralysis or hemiplegia 
 Sciatic nerve pain 
 Women Health 
 Dysmenorrhea (Painful Periods) 
 Premenstrual syndrome (PMS) 
 
 Side Effects 
 It should only be taken under strict medical supervision. In high doses, it may cause or worsen gastritis. 
 Note – It is to be avoided in children and pregnant women. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
